# Dr. Anil's Physiotherapy and Pain Relief Clinic

> Premier 5-star rated physiotherapy, osteopathy, and non-surgical pain relief clinic in Miyapur, Hyderabad. Founded and led by Dr. Anil Chand Gera (16+ years clinical experience, BPT, MIAP L-32650) with consultant Dr. Sudeeptha Meruga (17+ years experience, MPT Orthopaedics).

## Core Clinical Specializations
- Advanced Biomechanical Corrections (ABC Level-3) Osteopathy & Diversified Chiropractic Spine Manipulation
- Certified Diversified Needling Therapy (CSTA Reg. HR14202001660)
- Non-Surgical Sciatica, Slip Disc & Lumbar Spondylosis Decompression
- Knee Osteoarthritis & Joint Preservation Therapy (Avoiding/Delaying Surgery)
- Sports Injury Rehabilitation & Return-to-Sport Training (ACL, Meniscus, Rotator Cuff, Ankle Sprains)
- Positional Release Therapy (PRT - Physioneeds Academy, London UK) & Kinesiology Taping (ISSA)
- Post-Operative Orthopedic Rehabilitation (TKR, THR, Spine Surgery)
